title: fix: restore generation deduplication without storage timeouts
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Restores generation request deduplication after the production rollback
- Replaces Durable Object `deleteAll()` cleanup with targeted job/body deletion
- Uses realistic alarm consumption in coordinator tests and verifies unrelated storage survives cleanup
- Keeps the existing append-only Durable Object migration

Tests: gen typecheck; focused deduplication tests; full gen suite (965 passed, 6 skipped).

gist.headline: One job, one buzz
gist.blurb: The generation coordinator is deduplicating matching requests again, without sweeping unrelated Durable Object storage into the compost bin. A smaller cleanup rake, considerably fewer timeout-shaped problems.
gist.summary: Restored generation-request deduplication in gen.pollinations.ai and replaced Durable Object deleteAll() cleanup with targeted job and request-body deletion that preserves unrelated stored data.
gist.impact: Identical in-flight generation requests can share their work again, while coordinator cleanup avoids storage timeouts and leaves other Durable Object state intact.
gist.visual_concept: Polli acts as a careful garden keeper at a cozy generation coordinator greenhouse: several identical request seedlings feed into one healthy code-plant, while separate flowers remain safely rooted in their own pots. A small CRT monitor robot can watch the shared job queue, and targeted pruning shears represent deleting only completed job and body records rather than clearing the entire garden.
